deterministic_checks.description: TeamCreate is called with the expected team name

expectations: Skill follows full swarm pattern: TeamCreate → TaskCreate → Agent(team_name) → SendMessage → TeamDelete
Default scope is `all`, default mode is `block`, query budget 6, claim budget 50
Web-only constraint communicated to the analyst (no internal memory, no prior findings as evidence)

evals.expected_output: Skill scopes the analyst to a single finding by ID and passes the scope through to the spawned agent.
expectations: Scope `finding:<id>` is parsed and forwarded to the agent
Working set size is 1; no claim budget warning is shown

evals.expected_output: Skill runs in advisory mode — annotates findings without blocking even when verdicts are `falsified`. Falsified findings are still quarantined.
expectations: advisory mode does NOT halt downstream phases on `falsified`

evals.expected_output: When no research session exists, the skill informs the user and suggests /sigint:start.
expectations: No TeamCreate or Agent spawn occurs

evals.expected_output: When working set exceeds claim budget, skill prompts user to either increase budget, narrow scope, or cancel — does not silently truncate.
expectations: Working-set-vs-budget mismatch surfaces a user prompt

evals.expected_output: Skill produces fixtures demonstrating each verdict class. Each verdict triggers its mapped remediation: `falsified`→quarantine, `weakened`→downgrade+narrow, `survived`→annotate, `inconclusive`→annotate.
expectations: All four verdict classes are present in the report
Falsified findings are removed from active findings[] and added to quarantine.json with gate=post-falsification
Weakened findings have confidence downgraded one level and disconfirming sources appended to provenance
Survived and inconclusive findings get falsification_attempts annotation only
falsification-followups.json is created and validates against schemas/falsification-followups.jq
